findings.reason: The scan’s numbered glyph series is not individually identified here, so that gap remains unresolved. The article’s claim about the Shang numeral form as accumulated strokes normalized as 亖, its numeral use, and continuation alongside 四 is supported by the independently transcribed and scan-verified prose in X-118eac796eaf633cee01; the article does not rely on identities of the adjacent numbered glyph drawings.

The rare glyph drawings on the continuation page remain individually unidentified. The article’s distinct proposal that 四 was the original graph of 泗, depicting nasal discharge, and that the proposal lacks textual attestation is supported by the scan-verified transcription of the continuation prose in X-118eac796eaf633cee01. No article claim relies on identifying the nearby drawings.
